About Us:     Renowned for our technical excellence, ATC Williams provides Tailings, Water, and Waste Management services to the mining, resources, and governments sectors. We are a leading specialised engineering and consulting firm with over 40 years of successful service to our clients. With eight national office locations and a broad variety of international projects, we offer exciting and sustainable career pathways, whether you are a technical or professional leader, or just starting out in your career.     Why Join Us?     You will be joining our team at an exciting time as ATC Williams continue to solidify our position as a trusted and recognised engineering brand. We are embarking on a significant growth phase, represented by expansion in office locations, employees, opportunities, and capabilities.     About the Role:     We are continually looking for enthusiastic and talented people to join our team.    Our  Perth  office is currently seeking an  Experienced Engineer  on a  permanent full-time  basis.    You will work with our well experienced Civil, Geotechnical and Tailings groups to deliver projects successfully to meeting our clients’ needs. At ATC Williams, every role is supported by professionals across the business, and you will have peers, subordinates, and technical experts to share ideas with, through the varied nature of work we undertake for clients in the mining and resources, energy and property/general infrastructure sectors across Australia and globally.    You will have the opportunity to challenge yourself and fellow professionals through the works we undertake covering civil and geotechnical site investigation, materials test planning, laboratory testing, modelling, engineering analyses and design, construction, field inspections and tailings life cycle management (from concept to closure).        Key responsibilities and activities include:         An uncompromised commitment to safety in all aspects of your work including Safety in Design and promoting a safety culture in every aspect of your work.    Strong work ethic and the ability to work independently and in a team environment.    Assist in developing proposals for new work, including project scoping and costing.    Managing project tasks / small projects under the guidance of senior staff / Project Managers.    Undertaking and / or assisting in managing / overseeing geotechnical investigations including site work, laboratory and desktop investigations and preparing factual and interpretative reports.    Undertake technical design tasks and preparation of related documentation (under the guidance of senior staff / project managers), including geotechnical and hydraulic analyses such as stability, seepage, flood management and infrastructure design assessments.    Working at the direction of senior technical staff or technical experts.    Assist in developing practical solutions to add value to our clients needs.    Ensuring time management and quality to required standards to meet project requirements.    Work as part of a project team, delivering technical tasks and reports that summarise outcomes of the projects, including the review of construction records and verification of design implementation against project requirements.    Liaise with clients, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams to support project delivery, technical coordination and stakeholder communication.    Undertake numerical modelling and engineering assessments to support design development, risk evaluation and project decision-making.    Knowledge sharing, mentoring junior staff and working collaboratively with local and global teams.     Read more: https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5990095

result.description:
Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and dynamic Travel Sales Consultant to join our team. In this role, your primary focus will be face-to-face sales, actively engaging with potential clients on the streets and in hostels, especially targeting backpackers. You will use innovative networking strategies to build genuine relationships and guide travellers towards the best experiences our destinations have to offer.

Key Responsibilities:

- Proactively approach and engage with travellers on the streets and in hostels.
- Network with backpackers, using innovative strategies to build lasting relationships.
- Recommend the best tours, activities, and experiences based on travellers' interests.
- Continuously improve communication and sales skills through provided training and coaching.
- Collaborate in a diverse environment, connecting with people from various backgrounds.

Benefits:

- Competitive Annual Salary: $73,000 - $93,000 + super
- Attractive commissions and bonuses.
- Continuous sales training and leadership development.
- Free travel on tours and experiences.
- Exclusive discounts on transport and accommodation.

Qualifications:

- Valid working visa for Australia.
- Proven experience in face-to-face sales or a similar role.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to connect with strangers.
- Passion for travel and sharing experiences.
- Multilingual skills are a significant advantage.
- Previous sales and travel experience is a huge bonus.
- AQF Cert II or 1+ years of experience required.

Are You the Perfect Fit?
Do you thrive in face-to-face interactions? Can you approach strangers, connect with them, and offer tailored travel solutions? If you are innovative in building relationships and have a knack for sales, you might be the perfect addition to our team! Apply now and start your adventure with Happy Travels!

How to Apply:
Kickstart your journey with Happy Travels by sending through your CV and cover letter, highlighting your suitability and passions, to careers@happytravels.com.au.

Job Types: Full-time

Pay: $79,500 - $99,500 per year + super

Benefits:
- Employee discount
- Employee mentoring program
- Referral program

Schedule:
- Day shift

Supplementary Pay:
- Commission
- Performance bonus

Application Question(s):
- Which visa are you on and have you completed your 88 days?

Experience:
Sales: 1 year (Preferred)
Language: English (Required)
Work Authorisation: Australia (Required)
Work Location: In person

Dunsteel Engineering Pty Ltd

Location - Moss Vale NSW

Dunsteel Engineering Pty Ltd is a leading steel fabrication business with over 50 years of experience. We specialise in delivering complex projects for leading building firms and architects. Dunsteel are at the forefront of prefabricated stairway design for large multistorey buildings. We are currently seeking to fill the position of Welder who will be responsible for:

Main task:
Read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and standards to establish the job requirements.
Plan the work sequence accordingly.
Select and prepare metal stock.
Carry out trial fits for mechanical/structural assemblies.
Conduct welding operations to build armoured steel welded assemblies in accordance with the Drawings, Quality Standards and Safety requirements.
Finish product by cleaning, polishing, filing, or bathing in acid solutions, or by applying protective or decorative coatings.
Exam, use and maintain tools and equipment safely.
Maintaining appropriate stock levels of spare parts
Conduct quality checks to ensure welded components meet industry standards and project specifications.

Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications:
Relevant Trade Qualification
At least 2 years relevant experience
Strong proficiency in Mig welding techniques and processes.
Knowledge of welding equipment and tools, and ability to perform routine maintenance.
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and quality in work.
Work Health Safety (WHS) knowledge

Salary Range
$75,000-$85,000 annually

Position
Full Time

If you meet the above criteria please apply now, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Since 1981, Shadbolt Group has grown to become a leading cost-effective engineering solutions provider. We are proud of our professional performance on each and every project. Our aim is to build long term relationships with our clients based on trust, accountability and integrity. It is our dedication to quality that gives our clients a competitive advantage.

This goes hand in hand with our diligence and engineering excellence. From pipework projects to tank manufacturing, structural works, machine building or site work. Shadbolt Group is committed to providing prompt and precise delivery from our highly trained team of experts. The requirements of each client are always the focus of everything we do.

We are seeking qualified Pressure Welders to join our growing professional team. We seek reliable, team-oriented individuals with high integrity who will positively contribute to the company's success. We offer short-term contracts with above-award pay rates fully guaranteed under current workplace regulations.
Position available across our site and work locations in NSW, SA, WA and VIC.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to determine and perform appropriate welding techniques for the task at hand
Set up equipment and weld parts, using appropriate pressure welding equipment and methods
Examine welds for width of bead, penetration and precision, and performs necessary repairs or reworks
Weld and repair pressure vessels and pipes to relevant high-quality standards and ensure conformance with standard specifications
Fabricate metal components in accordance with supplied drawings and specifications
Conduct tests on welds to ensure there are no leaks in the pressurised systems
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Apply post-weld treatments to relieve stress and enhance the strength of the welded joints on pressure-containing equipment
Diagnose faults and perform operational maintenance on machines and equipment in order to restore full functionality and safety performance, maintaining a condition that does not compromise safety
Maintain tools and equipment to a professional standard
Keep the workstation clean and orderly to retain a safe and operational work environment
Clean and prepare metal surfaces for welding by flame cutting, heat cutting, gouging, bevelling, grinding or filing
Manage workflow, meet deadlines, and troubleshoot problems on a daily basis, in addition to fabrication duties

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade qualified
Minimum of three years of experience in this role or similar
Ability to work independently and in a team environment to complete large and complex projects
Critical thinking
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Precision skills
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Safety focus
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Salary: $49.00/hour, 38 hours per week + Super
